dialogue.origin: こんばんはよろしくお願いいたします。時間になりましたら始めさせて頂きたいと思います
dialogue.content: Good evening. Thank you for joining me. I'd like to get started as it's our appointment time.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします！
dialogue.content: Good evening. Pleased to meet you!

dialogue.origin: こんばんわ。相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。始めに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えて頂けますか？
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm your counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.origin: 33歳女性、恋愛の事で悩んでいます。
dialogue.content: I’m a 33-year-old woman, and I’m struggling with a relationship issue.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。どのような事ですか？
dialogue.content: Thank you. Could you tell me more about it?

dialogue.origin: 10年付き合っている彼氏がいます。彼は既婚者で、なかなか離婚できなくて、でも離婚の努力をしてくれています。ただ、私も年齢の事を考えたらどうしようかと思って・・・
dialogue.content: I have a boyfriend I've been with for 10 years. He's married, and he's having a hard time getting a divorce, but he is trying. It's just that, when I think about my age, I start to wonder what I should do...

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。それは苦しいですよね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 彼はどのようにあなたに言われているのですか？
dialogue.content: What has he been saying to you about it?

dialogue.origin: もともと、夫婦仲は悪くて、離婚して私と一緒になりたいと言ってくれてました。
dialogue.content: Originally, he told me that he and his wife weren't on good terms, and that he wanted to divorce her to be with me.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。それを聴くと待ってしまいますし、期待もしますよね
dialogue.content: I understand. Hearing that would make you want to wait and give you hope, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: お相手の年齢はおいくつですか？
dialogue.content: How old is your partner?

dialogue.origin: 38歳です。
dialogue.content: He's 38.

dialogue.origin: あなたも彼もとてもお若い時からお付き合いされていたのですね。
dialogue.content: So you've both been together since you were quite young.

dialogue.origin: とても長い二人の関係が伝わってきます
dialogue.content: I can sense how long and deep your relationship has been.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます私の親はこのことを知っています。彼も、私と本気で一緒になりたいと思ってくれていて、5年前に裁判したのですが負けてしまいました。
dialogue.content: Thank you. My parents know about this. He's also serious about wanting to be with me, and he even took it to court five years ago, but he lost.

dialogue.origin: 裁判をされたのですね
dialogue.content: So he went to court.

dialogue.origin: 今彼は相手家族と同居されているのですか？
dialogue.content: Is he currently living with his family?

dialogue.origin: 今は、別居中です
dialogue.content: Right now, they're living apart.

dialogue.origin: 正しく言えば単身赴任中です
dialogue.content: To be precise, he's on a solo work assignment away from home.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。少し心は落ち着かれているのではないでしょうか。そしてとても複雑なお気持ちなのではないですか？
dialogue.content: I see. I imagine that gives you a little peace of mind. And yet, you must have very complicated feelings about it all.

dialogue.origin: はい、とても複雑なので相談しました。とても素敵な彼で、ルックスも性格も私の理想の人です。誠実な人なので、私の為のいつも悩んでくれています
dialogue.content: Yes, it's very complicated, which is why I came to talk about it. He's a wonderful man—his looks and personality are exactly my ideal. He's a sincere person, and he's always worrying about what's best for me.

dialogue.origin: お優しい素敵な彼氏のですね
dialogue.content: He sounds like a kind and wonderful boyfriend.

dialogue.origin: 今１０年待っている感じですが、今の状態をどのようにされたいと思われますか？
dialogue.content: It seems like you've been waiting for 10 years now. What would you like to do about the current situation?

dialogue.origin: 不倫していて、誠実もないでしょうけど、私に対しては誠実です
dialogue.content: I know it might not sound sincere since he's having an affair, but with me, he is sincere.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 正直、子供が欲しいなと思っていますが、この状態では、苦労するだけだし、相手も子供いるので困らせてしまうと思います。ちゃんとなってからと思っているのですが、高齢出産になってしまったり、親の事を考えると、別れた方が幸せなのかな？って思うけど・・・。彼は一生懸命なので別れるのも辛いなとか、色々考えてしまっています
dialogue.content: Honestly, I'm starting to want children. But in this situation, it would just be a hardship, and he already has children, so I think it would just cause him more trouble. I keep thinking I should wait until things are official, but then I worry about having a child at an older age, and when I think about my parents... I wonder if it would be better for my happiness to break up with him. But he's trying so hard, so the thought of leaving him is painful. I'm just thinking about so many things.

dialogue.origin: 好きな事は止められないですものね。でも辛いですよね
dialogue.content: You can't just stop loving someone. But it's very painful, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、何かをあきらめなければいけない事が辛いです
dialogue.content: Yes, what's painful is that I have to give something up.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。。ひとつお聞きしたいのですが、お子様はあなたと付き合われる前からいたのですか？
dialogue.content: I understand... I'd like to ask one thing: did he have children before he started dating you?

dialogue.origin: はい、いました。奥さんの立場になったら奥さんも辛いと思いますが、奥さんは彼の事を奴隷のように扱っていました。まだ、恋愛感情がない時に、会ったことがあるのですが、その時から、みんなでその彼の事が可哀そうだねって言っていました。
dialogue.content: Yes, he did. I know his wife must be in pain too if I think from her perspective, but she treated him like a slave. I met her once before there were any romantic feelings between us, and even back then, everyone used to say how sorry they felt for him.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, so that's how it was.

dialogue.origin: はい、なので、離婚は元々私とこうなる前から考えていたようです
dialogue.content: Yes, so it seems he was thinking about divorce even before things started between us.

dialogue.origin: それでも彼は分かれないのはどうしてだとお考えになりますか？
dialogue.content: Why do you think he hasn't been able to separate from her, then?

dialogue.origin: 奥さんが離婚をしてくれません。仕事していないので、金銭的に不安なのでは？と思いますが
dialogue.content: His wife won't agree to the divorce. She doesn't work, so I think maybe she's financially insecure.

dialogue.origin: なるほど、そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see, that makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 借金もしているみたいなので。
dialogue.content: It seems she's also in debt.

dialogue.origin: それはあなたも相手の子供の事を考えるとどうしていいのか悩むのも無理もないと感じました。もしもこのまま、離婚されない場合どう考えていますか？
dialogue.content: Considering he has children with her, I can certainly understand why you're struggling with what to do. If he's not able to get a divorce, what do you think you would do?

dialogue.origin: 離婚できなかったら、私は子供をあきらめるしかないと思っています。内縁の妻みたいになるんですかね？
dialogue.content: If he can't get divorced, I think I'd have to give up on having children. Would I end up like a common-law wife?

dialogue.origin: 私は、それでいいと思っていたのですが、最近親が子供の事を言い出して、迷い始めています
dialogue.content: I used to think I was okay with that, but recently my parents have started talking about children, and I’ve begun to waver.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。。知り合いで内縁の妻で出産された方もいます。そのお覚悟はありますか？
dialogue.content: I see... I know someone who had a child as a common-law wife. Do you have the resolve for that?

dialogue.origin: 友人は、親にも反対されていましたが、二人の子供を出産しました
dialogue.content: My friend's parents were against it, but she had two children.

dialogue.origin: 正直、怖いです。なので、ここで別れた方がいいのか、それとも、子供をあきらめるか。でも親不孝をしていいいのか？って思っています
dialogue.content: Honestly, it scares me. So I’m wondering whether I should break up now, or give up on having children. And I also wonder whether it’s okay to disappoint my parents.

dialogue.origin: 今、彼は金銭的に余裕がなく、奥さんが作った借金も返しながら、家にもお金入れて、単身赴任しています。私が子供を産んだらそれどころじゃなくなりますよね・・・
dialogue.content: Right now, he doesn't have much money. He's paying off the debts his wife made, sending money to her home, and living on his own for his work assignment. If I had a child, he wouldn't be able to manage at all...

dialogue.origin: そうですね。とても辛い選択ですね。この１０年はとても大切な期間だったのですね。
dialogue.content: Yes, that's a very difficult choice to make. These past 10 years must have been a very precious time for you.

dialogue.origin: すごく幸せでした。本当に。でも、自分の未来を考えると、このままではいけないと感じ始めてきました。私は、反対されながら子供を産む勇気はないかもです。
dialogue.content: I was incredibly happy. Truly. But when I think about my future, I've started feeling that I can't continue like this. I might not have the courage to have a child while facing opposition.

dialogue.origin: お子さんを生むのは、それは親御さんの為ですか？あなたの人生のためですか？
dialogue.content: Is having a child for your parents? Or is it for your own life?

dialogue.origin: もともと、子供はいらないと思っていました。でも30歳になった時に、この人との子供だったら欲しいなって思い始めてきました。なので、どちらかというと自分の為かな？って思ってはいます
dialogue.content: Originally, I didn't think I wanted children. But when I turned 30, I started to think that I would want a child if it was with him. So, I guess you could say it's more for myself.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: せっかく女で生まれてきたので、子供が産めるのであればとは思います
dialogue.content: Since I was born a woman, I feel that if I'm able to have a child, I'd like to.

dialogue.origin: 10年間、お子様がいて借金もある男性とお付き合いされていて、離婚をできない、
dialogue.content: For 10 years, you've been with a man who has children and debts, and he can't get a divorce,

dialogue.origin: そして
dialogue.content: and

dialogue.origin: 子供を考えているという事をお悩みという事で
dialogue.content: you are troubled about the prospect of having children,

dialogue.origin: これからどうするかという事でしたが、
dialogue.content: and about what to do from here,

dialogue.origin: ご自分の人生の為決断されたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: have you come to a decision for your own life?

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・。今、お話している中で、私は彼との子供が欲しいのかなって思いました。子持ち、借金持ち、既婚者というワードだけだと、変な男にひっかかったなぁと思われるけど、借金も自分借金ではないし、離婚する為にお金や労力を注いできてくれました。まだ、悩んでいるけど、私は彼を選ぶかもしれません
dialogue.content: Yes... As we've been talking, I think I've realized that I do want his child. If you just hear the words 'has kids,' 'in debt,' 'married,' it sounds like I've gotten involved with a bad guy, but the debt isn't his, and he's poured so much money and effort into trying to get a divorce. I'm still conflicted, but I think I might choose him.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうなのですね。周りの意見に流されずに貫きとおす気持ちも素敵だと、感じましたが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. I feel that your resolve not to be swayed by others’ opinions and to follow through is admirable. How does that sit with you?

dialogue.origin: いろんな家族、状況があると思います。
dialogue.content: I believe there are all kinds of families and situations.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。なかなか、ここまで、合う男性はないような気がします。形はどうあれ、自分が幸せと思えるような人生を歩みたいなと思います、親は私の人生だから、自分で決めなさいと言ってくれています
dialogue.content: That's true. I feel like I'll never find another man I connect with this well. Whatever form it takes, I want to live a life where I can feel happy. My parents have told me, 'It's your life, so you decide.'

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。戸籍では少し勇気がいると思いますが、自分が幸せだと思える道は素敵だと感じます。
dialogue.content: I see. It might take some courage in terms of official family registration, but I feel that choosing a path where you can feel happy is a wonderful thing.

dialogue.origin: はい、今後の事を、彼に言うと負担になるかなって思って我慢してきましたが、少しずつわがままを出せるようになっていきます
dialogue.content: Yes. I've been holding back because I thought telling him about my feelings for the future would be a burden, but I'm going to start expressing what I want more, little by little.

dialogue.origin: あなたが彼のよりどころなのかもしれません
dialogue.content: Perhaps you are his source of comfort and support.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: That might be true.

dialogue.origin: まわりよりも、ご自身の思いを大切にされても良いのかと感じました。
dialogue.content: I feel it's okay to prioritize your own feelings over those of people around you.

dialogue.origin: そろそろお時間ですが、お話されていかでしたか？
dialogue.content: Our time is almost up. How do you feel after talking today?

dialogue.origin: いかがでしたか？です
dialogue.content: I meant, how was it for you?

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。少し、自分の本当の気持ちが見えてきたので良かったと思います。
dialogue.content: Thank you. I think it was good, because I've started to see my own true feelings a little more clearly.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。いろんな家族がいてると思います。あなたが幸せと思える選択をしてくださいね
dialogue.content: I'm glad to hear that. I believe there are many different kinds of families. Please make the choice that you feel will bring you happiness.

dialogue.origin: はい、そうします
dialogue.content: Yes, I will.

dialogue.origin: それではお時間ですので終了いたしますがよろしいでしょうか。？
dialogue.content: Well then, our time is up. Shall we conclude for today?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。またお話にいらしてくださいね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you. Please feel free to come and talk again anytime. Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

dialogue.origin: （クライエント役ありがとうございました。また注意点よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: (Thank you for playing the client role. I look forward to your feedback.)

dialogue.origin: （承知しました。ありがとうございました。またご縁がありましたらよろしくお願いします。）
dialogue.content: (Understood. Thank you. I hope we have the chance to work together again.)

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。では、失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Thank you. Well then, goodbye.

dialogue.origin: 失礼します
dialogue.content: Goodbye.

topic.sub: 既婚者との関係における将来の選択肢
